race.title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
race.verdict: AUTUMN'S BREEZE needs to brush up on her starts but a change in headgear may help on that score and she now finds herself back down in 0-65 company so could prove good enough in a trappy contest. Notable Charm has been shaping well and is one to take seriously up against older horses, while Chilli King is only just finding his feet and should improve further for the step up to 2m. AUTUMN'S BREEZE (IRE) NOTABLE CHARM CHILLI KING
